items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wow. You know Roswell Rudd, the trombone player, mentioned that group. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Yup. There is a band that has played almost as long, Eli’s Chosen Six from Yale. But I play with some of those guys all the time and they do not donate any jazz to their alma mater, they play less frequently and they are paid, and extremely well paid for their work.
Wow. You know Roswell Rudd, the trombone player, mentioned that group.
